CustomField.description: Identifies the current run of this chain. The framework sets a new value when the chain starts, when the watchdog starts a stuck run again or ends it, and when an operator retries it. Each job checks the value before it saves, so a job left over from an earlier run cannot change a run that was started again. Shown read-only on the record page for diagnostics.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Identifies the current run of this chain. The framework issues a new value when the chain starts or is recovered, so leftover jobs from an earlier run can no longer change this record. Managed automatically; shown for diagnostics.
CustomField.label: Run Key
